purpose: One observed-plane reconstruction candidate, with acquisition held fixed within each paired comparison. Previously inspected development scenes, not independent validation.

algorithm.plane: material height h=a*x+b*y+c; least squares over distinct observed vertices, with known base/reference subtracted
algorithm.connectivity: edge-adjacent local ray-grid triangles; seed is smallest unassigned triangle id; seed neighbor minimizes (maximum fit residual, triangle id); frontier growth in ascending triangle id; every accepted growth must satisfy residual threshold over all unique vertices; failed unpaired seeds are rejected permanently
algorithm.unsupported_triangles: reject triangles without a consistent supported patch; no fallback to original mixed triangle
algorithm.observed_support: union of accepted local triangle domains; this is interpolation support, not directly observed area
algorithm.model_support: inside convex hull of patch observed vertices, and at most 0.05 m from nearest patch vertex; used only absent observed support; does not establish visibility or continuity across gaps
algorithm.within_view: observed candidates first; incompatible heights spanning more than 0.002 m cause abstention; otherwise conventional median
algorithm.between_views: observed candidates first, model candidates only absent observed; conventional median as control; no maximum or trimming
algorithm.truth_free: estimator inputs only frame bytes and optional reference offset; no scene labels, truth volumes, true planes or residual feedback

assessment.eligible_total: 400 supported cells and no invalid/unavailable input; disclose model-only support and distinguish model-based totals
assessment.partial: never use partial volume as approved total; unsupported cells not zero-filled
domains: paired common support within same acquisition
assessment.candidate_gate: All nine primary acquisition scenes must have eligible total <=5%; do not trade lost coverage for lower common-domain error. Passing development would justify preregistering R007, not deployment or accuracy guarantee.

limitations: plane tolerance is engineering assumption, not calibrated uncertainty
convex hull can bridge unobserved boundaries
several coplanar points do not prove intervening surface
nine scenes correlated and already inspected
parameter selection cannot be presented as blinded validation
pre_score_smoke: One archived center fixed3 acquisition was decoded by implementer without truth or scoring; 382 supported cells reported. Algorithm and parameters were declared before that smoke. Not blinded even as to coverage.
